structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions
Licensure and Certification of Other Practitioners of the Healing Arts

law.catch_line: Requisite training and educational achievements of acupuncturists
law.text: The Board shall establish a testing program to determine the training and educational achievements of acupuncturists, or the Board may accept other evidence such as successful completion of a national certification examination, experience, or completion of an approved training program in lieu of testing and shall establish this as a prerequisite for approval of the licensee's application.
